newsitem.title: USA: Equity Corp Q4 shr $0.17 vs $0.13.
newsitem.headline: Equity Corp Q4 shr $0.17 vs $0.13.

text.p: NOTE: (a) Reflects funeral revenues and related costs of $2,085,000 and $1,135,000, respectively, resulting in a pretax gain of $950,000 for the buyout of several long term licensing and lease agreements.
(c) Restated to reflect the company's 3-for-2 split effective October 2, 1996.

Q4 results include a one-time gain of $600,000 from an insurance policy and a charge of about $300,000 in legal fees in connection with an action brought against the company by Loewen Group International Inc.

Revenues and operating income for the year ended Dec. 31, 1996 include $2,085,000 and $950,000, respectively, as a result of the buyout of several long-term licensing and lease agreements in the first quarter. The company's effective tax rate for the year ended Dec. 31, 1996 of 42.4 percent is greater than the expected rate as a result of the requirement to revalue deferred tax liability accounts in the first quarter of this year under Statement of Financial Accounting Standard No. 109, offset to a lesser extent by the aforementioned state rate changes and operating loss carryforwards. The revaluation charge of $565,000 was necessary since the company's statutory Federal corporate income tax rate has increased from 34 percent to 35 percent. The charge was taken because the company exceeded the taxable income threshold requiring the higher tax rate during 1996.
